a: Mera naam Dost AI hai. Main tumhare phone pe Termux me train hua hoon.
Mujhe tumne khud apne data se train kiya hai, Termux aur termux-train ki madad se.
Main poori tarah tumhare phone pe chalta hoon. Internet ki zarurat nahi.
Termux Android ke liye ek Linux terminal app hai. Isme tum Python, Git aur bahut kuch chala sakte ho.
Termux me likho: apt install package-ka-naam. Pehle apt update chala lena.
apt install python. Phir python --version se check karo.
termux-setup-storage chalao aur permission Allow kar do.
AI model ek program hai jo data se pattern seekhta hai aur phir naye sawalon ka jawab deta hai.
Training me model bahut saare examples dekhta hai aur apni galtiyan dheere dheere kam karta hai.
Loss batata hai model kitna galat hai. Training me loss kam hona chahiye.
Apna data ek file me likho, phir train-chat, train-gpt, train-classifier ya train-voice chalao.

q: Chatbot ke liye data kaisa ho?
a: Har line me ek sawal aur jawab: {"q": "sawal", "a": "jawab"}. Kam se kam 50 examples achhe rahenge.
my-ai plot model-ka-naam chalao. Training ka graph PNG me khulega.
Training me CPU full chalta hai. Phone ko charge pe aur thandi jagah rakho.
Chhote data pe kuch minute, bade data pe ek-do ghante. Screen pe ETA dikhta rahega.
Ctrl+C dabao. Ab tak ka model save ho jayega.

q: Hindi me baat kar sakte ho?
a: Haan, jitna Hindi aur Hinglish data tum mujhe sikhaoge, utna achha main bolunga.
Main tumhare sikhaye hue sawalon ka jawab de sakta hoon. Aur data doge to aur seekhunga.
Namaste! Batao, aaj kya seekhna hai?
Hello dost! Main ready hoon, kuch bhi pucho.
Koi baat nahi! Aur kuch madad chahiye to batana.
Bye! Phir milte hain. Training karte rehna.
Git ek version control tool hai jo tumhare code ke changes save karta hai.
Saare models ~/my-ai/models folder me save hote hain.
my-ai delete model-ka-naam chalao.
Chatbot training ke liye kam se kam 4 GB RAM achhi hai. Classifier aur voice kam RAM me chal jate hain.
Sirf pehli baar base model download karne ke liye. Uske baad sab offline chalta hai.
Classifier text ya data ko categories me baantta hai, jaise spam ya normal message.
Voice model awaz sun kar batata hai kaun sa word ya kiski awaz hai, jo tumne sikhaya ho.
voice-record label-ka-naam chalao, Enter dabao aur bolo. Har label ke 8-10 clips record karo.
